[quote=new_westmore;61423858]"Well, if the government gets shut down, a dissolution can be called, where both the Senate and Commons get dismissed and a new election is called. We're lucky enough to have barely ever have this happen, save for like this one time in the 60s or something; though that was when we were a colony of Llyndorra, for what that's worth."

Ah, if you want a cultural exchange thing (tourism) we can try and get at least 750,000 a year to visit NV. [/quote]

I don't understand

[quote=the_new_las_vegas;61425653]I don't understand [/quote]
A group of the wealthiest of my country has formed an opposition regime, more importantly they seek to control all the resources in Dushkaria and wring it dry. And your little island seems like a tax heaven and is far enough from the Dushkari government.

[quote=the_new_las_vegas;61425702]I'm trying to run a respectable credible regime over here. I'm not going to tolerate illegal or corrupting behavior on my island[/quote]

I can get a lot more money from places that don't require the complete destruction of my administration's morals and integrity

[quote=the_new_las_vegas;61425731]I can get a lot more money from places that don't require the complete destruction of my administration's morals and integrity[/quote]
Come on, why not. You'd gain free access to Dushkari resources.

There is "legal", which I like

And there is "illegal" which in your case sounds like a bunch of rich people coming to cause chaos

[quote=the_new_las_vegas;61425779]There is "legal", which I like

And there is "illegal" which in your case sounds like a bunch of rich people coming to cause chaos[/quote]
They wouldn't cause chaos in your country, they merely seek to avoid it by going somewhere safe.

[quote=dushkaria;61425786]They wouldn't cause chaos in your country, they merely seek to avoid it by going somewhere safe.[/quote]
Asylum then?

Alright, I'll consider it. Tell me the full situation

[quote=the_new_las_vegas;61425805]Asylum then?

Alright, I'll consider it. Tell me the full situation [/quote]
The full situation is that the CEO's of the largest companies in Dushkaria revolted when the old government was overthrown. With The west of Dushkaria already in the firm grasp of the UMC (Dushkaria's largest mining corporation), it was trivial to essentially break free as the new government was too busy with the north. So they essentially formed the Corporate Territories to oppose both regimes in the hope to stay independent and do what they wish.

So they essentially formed the Corporate Territories to oppose both regimes in the hope to stay independent and do what they wish. [/quote]

They don't mind, they just want to be far away from Dushkaria.

[b]"...This internal conflict of the Capitalist Order between the barbarous Wuloosya and the incompetent Rosenmarkke is commendable; their actions further the inevitable decay of the Capitalist Order, though regrettably, it will decay into fascism and corporatism before reforming via revolution into a Socialist society. Even still, the suffering of the proletariat under fascism is a necessary evil for them to fully gain a consciousness of their power, which is called class consciousness. This conflict is a systemic one, the competition fostered by Capitalism, often to the detriment of mankind, pushes war. Stuipendia has never waged a conflict without just cause. The Great Technocratic Revolution was a righteous one, whereas nigh on every conflict waged by Capitalists is for their own benefit, and for the benefit of businessmen, compared to our singular and righteous conflict, which brought about the Perfect System from mere ink and theorem to reality. Wuloosya wages this war for their own benefit, to expand or dominate a foreign state for no good reason, which is condemnable. But, in this conflict, the seeds of a new revolution are planted, which is commendable..."[/b]
[sub][i]~ Overseer Superior LI JINPING, Extract from Li's Speech to the IA on the Wuloosya-Rosenmarkke Conflict 2028[/i][/sub]
